body:
Added source-build and installation instructions, user and architecture guides with ASCII diagrams, platform/product limitations, a scope-preserving roadmap and issue/PR templates. Updated the README, CLI, development and manual guides; marked historical requirements clearly while preserving their content and open obligations.

Verified on macOS ARM64: full local gate (255 Rust, 137 JavaScript and 12 Python tests), documentation links/anchors, rendered Markdown, host packaging and isolated installation/restart/stopped-copy recovery. Evidence: progress/2026-09-30-contributor-documentation.md.

The project license, supported-release/security decisions and outstanding physical-device/platform/reliability acceptance remain open. No application behavior, project scope, priority, dates or acceptance status was changed.

metadata.summary: Prepared current English self-build and contributor documentation with architecture diagrams.
